title: Missing Provider Root-Cause and Recovery Plan

finding.root_cause: Provider provenance exists in the legacy provider column but was not normalized into canonical source_provider; the refresh manifest therefore collapsed the cohort into __MISSING_PROVIDER__ and had no authorized route.
finding.caveat: The exact historical transformation step that dropped source_provider is not proven by the immutable dataset alone.

recovery_plan.action: Locate and validate immutable NSE acquisition evidence for nse_india_v2_17g.
recovery_plan.pass: Artifact hash, schema, source URL/version and 2,013-row lineage are reproducible.

recovery_plan.action: Implement a deterministic provider alias mapping from provider=nse_india_v2_17g to canonical source_provider.
recovery_plan.pass: Exactly 2,013 intended rows map; no unrelated rows change.

recovery_plan.action: Reconcile identities and row dispositions against the operational universe.
recovery_plan.pass: 2,013/2,013 dispositioned; 0 duplicate identity groups; no silent losses.

recovery_plan.action: Materialize a new immutable refresh candidate.
recovery_plan.pass: 14/14 provider buckets and hashes recorded; current pointer unchanged.

recovery_plan.action: Run delta, metadata, quality and rollback gates.
recovery_plan.pass: All blocking gates PASS and all real deltas classified.

recovery_plan.action: Issue explicit promotion or HOLD decision.
recovery_plan.pass: Human approval required before pointer mutation.
